integrity: Analysis relies on an explicit finite-dimensional ODE proof; finite numerical checks are supplementary. Originality is qualified by possible implicit coverage and has not received independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs, uniform unit hopping, one-site normalized initial data, fixed graph as Kerr parameter grows. Local uniform estimates only on bounded rescaled time; a global leading escape limit is separately established. Broader nonlinear perturbation literature may imply some components.
title: Geodesic and triangle fingerprints of strongly nonlinear quantum walks
